actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H1970-1971)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H1970-1971)
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 167.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H1970-1972)
Mr. Westerman moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects state reclamation agencies, federal land management agencies, community reclaimers, and local communities near abandoned mines.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes partnerships between States and nongovernmental entities for the purpose of reclaiming and restoring land and water resources

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts environmental remediation, water quality improvement, and liability structures for abandoned mine cleanup projects.
dimensions.evidence: remediate mine drainage on abandoned mine land and water impacted by abandoned mines

dimensions.assessment: Involves project cost estimates, financial resource requirements from community reclaimers, and cost reimbursement mechanisms.
dimensions.evidence: a cost estimate for the project and evidence that the Community Reclaimer has sufficient financial resources

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Surface Mining Control and Reclamation Act of 1977 to create new state-federal MOUs and community reclaimer project approvals.
dimensions.evidence: The Surface Mining Control and Reclamation Act of 1977 (30 U.S.C. 1201 et seq.) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes programs and partnerships regionally in states with approved programs, running temporarily until September 30, 2032.
dimensions.evidence: This Act shall be in effect until September 30, 2032.

missing_information: Total federal funding or aggregate monetary value of remediation projects anticipated under the new partnerships.
importance_detail.rationale: Allows states to establish Memoranda of Understanding for mine drainage remediation and authorizes partnerships with community reclaimers to restore abandoned mine lands until September 30, 2032.
